title: SPLA/193/2013 of Ramesh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
SPLA 193/2013
With
CRLA 510/2013
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate, for
the applicant/appellant.
Mr. HS Rawal, AGA, for the
State.
Delay has already been
condoned.
Despite service, private
respondent has not turned up.
Heard.
Leave to appeal is granted.
Appeal is admitted for hearing.
Issue fresh notice to the private
respondent.
Appellant shall take steps within
a week.
List after service report.
Meanwhile, summon the lower
court record.
